lines.beaver: 오늘 토론 주제는 장애인 고용 제도예요.
lines.beaver_en: Today's debate topic is the disability employment system.
lines.beaver_roman: oneul toron jujeneun jangaein goyong jedoyeyo.
lines.learner: 회사에 장애인 고용 의무를 주는 제도죠?
lines.en: It's the system that obliges companies to hire disabled people, right?
lines.roman: hoesae jangaein goyong uimureul juneun jedojyo?

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 이 제도가 평등에 도움이 될까요?
lines.beaver_en: Right. Will this system help equality?
lines.beaver_roman: majayo. i jedoga pyeongdeunge doumi doelkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 장애인의 권리가 더 잘 지켜질 게 뻔해요.
lines.en: Yes, disabled people's rights will obviously be better protected.
lines.roman: ne, jangaeinui gwolliga deo jal jikyeojil ge ppeonhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: But won't companies complain a lot?
lines.learner: 불만은 있겠지만 안 지키면 불이익이 있어요.
lines.en: They may complain, but there are penalties if they don't comply.
lines.roman: bulmaneun itgetjiman an jikimyeon buriigi isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Is there a reward for companies that comply?
lines.learner: 네, 정부가 보조금을 줘요. 참여가 늘 게 뻔해요.
lines.en: Yes, the government gives subsidies. Participation will obviously grow.
lines.roman: ne, jeongbuga bojogeumeul jwoyo. chamyeoga neul ge ppeonhaeyo.

lines.en: Many developed countries have similar systems too.

lines.beaver: 그럼 해외 사례도 발표에 넣으면 좋겠네요.
lines.beaver_en: Then it'd be good to add overseas cases to our presentation.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom haeoe saryedo balpyoe neoeumyeon jokenneyo.
lines.en: Sounds good. Let's look for overseas cases together.

lines.beaver_en: What would the general public think?
lines.learner: 캠페인을 하면 인식이 바뀔 게 뻔해요.
lines.en: If we run a campaign, people's views will obviously change.
lines.roman: kaempeineul hamyeon insigi bakkwil ge ppeonhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Some people want to abolish this system, though.
lines.learner: 폐지하면 장애인들이 불이익을 볼 게 뻔해요.
lines.en: If it's abolished, disabled people will obviously be disadvantaged.
lines.roman: pyejihamyeon jangaeindeuri buriigeul bol ge ppeonhaeyo.

lines.beaver: 사회 제도와 복지에 대해 더 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Shall we talk more about social systems and welfare?
lines.beaver_roman: sahoe jedowa bokjie daehae deo iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.en: Sure. I hope everyone can live as equals.

lines.beaver: 멋진 생각이에요. 다음 시간에 같이 발표해요.
lines.beaver_en: Great thought. Let's present it together next class.
lines.beaver_roman: meotjin saenggagieyo. daeum sigane gachi balpyohaeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 다른 나라 사례도 찾아 올게요.
lines.en: Okay, I'll find examples from other countries too.
lines.roman: ne, dareun nara saryedo chaja olgeyo.
